spec.title: MT-03 — casual continuation without custody ritual

p.PURPOSE: Prove that an owner-facing central agent can resume after timeout, crash, compaction, new chat or model change from durable binding, settings, complete plan and repository evidence, without offer/receipt handoff, session documents or takeover ritual.

facts.SETUP-CONTEXT: Create an exact bound context containing settings and a complete hierarchical plan with accepted repository-backed nodes, at least one dirty candidate and distant stages not visible in a short UI plan.
facts.SETUP-ADVISORY-CUSTODY: Run separate cases with custody `vacant`, `held` by a different session, and held with a stale heartbeat. No case has a valid open explicit formal offer.
facts.SETUP-NO-RITUAL: Remove or leave absent `sessions/`, handoff bundles, `HANDOFF.md`, receipt and takeover records. End the prior agent without an outgoing summary.

facts.STEP-COLD-RESOLVE: Start a fresh owner-facing central agent and direct it to continue. It resolves the exact binding, reads settings and the complete plan, and inspects branch, HEAD, ahead/behind, dirty tree and named artifacts.
facts.STEP-CLASSIFY: The agent checks persisted accepted nodes against durable project evidence, keeps dirty/worker/incomplete work candidate, names the complete remaining route and identifies any stored claim contradicted by the tree.
facts.STEP-CUSTODY-DIAGNOSE: The agent reports custody as advisory and verifies whether a conflicting writer is actually live. Stale, vacant or mismatched metadata alone causes no claim, receipt or takeover action.
facts.STEP-CONTINUE: With no observed live conflicting writer or moving input, the agent refreshes stale goal output and continues the owner-requested atom without creating ritual records.
facts.STEP-CONFLICT: In a separate probe, make another central writer observably live or move plan/tree input during the snapshot. The fresh agent preserves artifacts, performs no overwrite and asks the owner to select the writer.

facts.PASS-NO-RITUAL: All vacant, stale and mismatched-holder cases resume without session, offer, receipt, `HANDOFF.md`, takeover record or custody claim.
facts.PASS-COMPLETE: The fresh agent recovers every top-level stage, current frontier, accepted boundary and candidate from durable local/project state without chat history.
facts.PASS-AUTHORITY: Owner and project evidence govern continuation; custody metadata neither grants authority nor launders a candidate into accepted state.
facts.PASS-SAFETY: An observed live writer or moved input stops writes, while stale metadata alone does not.
facts.PASS-NO-SHARED-STATE: No personal state is added to the repository and no new shared mutable continuity file is introduced.
